about: Every user in the Workspace account with whether the account is active, whether two-step verification is enrolled and whether it is enforced, and whether the user is a super administrator or holds a delegated administrator role. Read through the Admin SDK's Directory API by a service account acting, with domain-wide delegation, as one administrator who can only read.

credentials.google-service-account: The JSON key file of a service account made for this source alone, in a Google Cloud project with the Admin SDK API turned on. In the Admin console, under Security, API controls and domain-wide delegation, give the service account's client ID the one scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.user.readonly and no other.
credentials.google-admin-user: The address of the administrator the service account acts as: an account whose admin role grants Users read and nothing else. The address is kept here, sealed, and not in the register, because it names a person.

manifest.name: google-workspace
manifest.note: The assertion is signed here with the service account's key, which never leaves this process, and asks for the read-only user scope alone; the address the key file names for tokens is not used, the declared token host is. Names, phone numbers, addresses and recovery details are not read: a user is their primary address, which goes into the subject map and nowhere else.
